ei.title: Peak Performance: Match Tasks to Energy
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: Research in the science of peak performance and motivation points to the fact that different tasks should ideally be matched to our energy level. For example, analytical tasks are best accomplished when our energy is high and we are free from distractions and able to focus. I generally wake up energized. Over the years, I have consistently stuck to the habit of "eating my problems for breakfast." I'm someone who tends to overthink different scenarios and conversations that haven't happened yet. When I procrastinate on talking with an unhappy client or dealing with an unpleasant email, I find I waste too much emotional energy during the day. It's as if the task hangs over my head, and I'll spend more time worrying about it, talking about it, and avoiding it, than it would actually take to just take care of it. So for me, it'll always be the first thing I get done. If you know you are not a morning person, be strategic about scheduling your difficult work later in the day.

det.korean: pleasant(유쾌한) → unpleasant(불쾌한): 미루게 되는 이메일이므로 '불쾌한'이 맥락에 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① analytical(분석적인): 에너지가 높을 때 잘 처리되는 과제 유형. 맥락 적절
❌ ② pleasant(유쾌한) — 원문은 unpleasant(불쾌한). 처리를 미루게 만드는 이메일이므로 '불쾌한'이 자연스러움 ←정답

det.korean: conserve(아끼다) → waste(낭비하다): 미루면 감정 에너지를 '낭비'한다는 맥락
det.analysis:

questions.passage: Research in the science of peak performance and motivation points to the fact that different tasks should ideally be matched to our energy level. For example, analytical tasks are best accomplished when our energy is high and we are free from distractions and able to focus. I generally wake up energized. Over the years, I have consistently stuck to the habit of "eating my problems for breakfast." I'm someone who tends to overthink different scenarios and conversations that haven't happened yet. When I procrastinate on talking with an unhappy client or dealing with an unpleasant email, I find I waste too much emotional energy during the day. It's as if the task hangs over my head, and I'll spend more time worrying about it, talking about it, and avoiding it, than it would actually take to just take care of it. So for me, it'll always be the first thing I get done. If you know you are not a morning person, be strategic about scheduling your difficult work later in the day.

det.korean: waste too much emotional energy(너무 많은 감정 에너지를 낭비하다)
det.analysis:

단어 수: waste(1) too(2) much(3) emotional(4) energy(5) = 5단어 ✅
det.tip: procrastinate → waste too much emotional energy: 미루는 것 = 감정 에너지 낭비
